_doc: Copy to <cache root>/import_sources.json (or point $PRICE_CACHE_SOURCES at it). Lists the folders import-existing reads. Paths may use ~ and $VARS.

sources.name: study-a
sources._fields:
names: plain | unquote | strip_prefix:

| omitted (mangled). req_start: listing (period1=0 / range=max) | YYYY-MM-DD the study used | omitted (first bar). events_requested: false if the study did not ask for div/splits. kind: yahoo_json (default) | binance_klines. ledger: the study's own fetch log for fetched_at (else file mtime); key=quote when file names are URL-quoted.

referenced._group_col: optional: one event has several candidate tickers; missing-report then also counts events with >=1 covered candidate; date_col: also count events whose date lies inside a candidate's data span
